source.method: Directed reachability over the snapshot graph (non-parking edges) for every entrance/exit pair, the planner's exact pairing rule; ramp identity from the snapshot's own OSM way tags and node topology; operator facility pages as already hashed in the catalog.
source.finding: Ten facilities paired with nothing but themselves. Nine bind the wrong ramp: the operator's real ramp is a route-relation member typed MAINLINE, so the builder's LINK-only candidate search fell back to the opposite-role ramp; one split interchange keeps its ramps beyond the 750 m radius; one exit bound a rest-area entry ramp. One facility is a per-route twin whose route carries no ramp of its own.
source.kept_as_is: 三溪園 西行き, 足立入谷 下り and 浦和北 下り entrances reach only their own onward stubs; that is the road, not the data. 八重洲線 facilities are UNAVAILABLE and stay unbound.

patches.reason: 新都心 is a split interchange: its 上り entrance and 下り exit ramps sit about 1.5 km from the catalog point, outside the builder's 750 m radius, so both roles bound the same short stub near the point and paired only with each other. The 上り entrance ramp way 283894031 starts at node 2877126783 and merges toward 与野 at node 2879195923; the 下り exit ramps 283919441 and 284163654 diverge at node 2877286249 from the carriageway fed by the 与野 side.

The 下り exit was bound to the 八潮PA (上り side) entry ramp osm.288896620, which now ends in parking edges. The 下り exit ramp way 1463660809 (motorway_link, destination=八潮入口 destination:ref=6) leaves the 6号三郷線 下り carriageway at node 13426271751 and ends at the plaza node 559433465. The way is a first OSM version; confirm against aerial imagery before relying on its exact geometry.
evidence: osm way 1463660809 name=首都高速道路 destination=八潮入口 destination:ref=6 highway=motorway_link oneway=yes

patches.reason: 横浜港北 is one interchange listed by the operator under 横浜北西線; its ramps carry only 横浜北線 (K7_YOKOHAMA_KITA) membership and already bind the K7_YOKOHAMA_KITA twin, which pairs with the whole network. This twin, with no ramp on its own route, fell back to twelve through-lane segments as both entrance and exit and paired only with itself. It is unbound like the other facilities without a ramp of their own.
